title: GardenProposals
description: What the scheduled Brain gardener returns: up to eight proposed hub notes or related sections, and nothing else. Each proposal is read as data, validated, and only then quarantined as a capture for review.

proposals.description: Zero or more proposals. An empty array is a legitimate answer: it means nothing is worth proposing.

kind.description: hub proposes a new hub note, related adds related links to an existing note.

target.description: The vault-relative path of the note the proposal is about.
